latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of UI/UX Pro Max - a comprehensive design intelligence skill for web and mobile.

- Covers 50+ visual styles, 161 curated color palettes, 57 font pairings, and 161 product types with reasoning rules.
- Contains 99 UX guidelines and 25 chart types across 10 technology stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, HTML/CSS).
- Provides actionable help for UI/UX planning, building, reviewing, optimizing, and refactoring across a wide range of projects and elements.
- Features a searchable database with priority-based recommendations (from Accessibility to Charts & Data).
- Integrates with shadcn/ui MCP for component search and code examples.
- Clearly defines when to apply, recommend, or skip this skill for design and development tasks.
